title: Macecontroler
description: A plugin that adds a 15-minute ritual when crafting Maces with particle effects. Each Mace gets a rank (1st, 2nd, 3rd). Only first Mace is enchantable. Limits total Maces on server and per player. Prevents storage in containers. Highly configurable.
body:
Ideas for new plugins i can make or need help with this plugin? add me on discord! my user is voidofvortexx

MaceControl transforms the Mace into a legendary, server-wide artifact. Instead of instant crafting, players trigger a dramatic 15-minute ritual with spectacular particle effects, creating memorable events that the entire server witnesses.

Author: VoidofVortexx
i am a small dev and not perfect so expect bugs, if u find any please dm me on discord please =D

---

Key Features

 **🔥 Epic Crafting Ritual**
- 15-minute ceremony with 15+ particle effects (sky beams, orbital rings, meteor showers, etc.)
- Spinning ingredients (Breeze Rod & Heavy Core) that accelerate and merge dramatically
- Boss bar showing progress, rank, time, and location
- Server-wide announcements when rituals start and complete
- Ambient sounds with dynamic pitch and dramatic completion effects

 **🎖️ Ranked System**
- Each Mace receives a unique rank (1st, 2nd, 3rd, etc.) and persistent UUID
- Holder tracking - admins can see who owns which Mace
- Custom naming - Maces display their rank
- Enchantability - only first X Maces can be enchanted (configurable)

 **🚫 Strict Limitations**
- Server limit - max Maces that can exist (default: 3)
- Inventory limit - max per player (default: 1)
- Ritual limit - one active ritual at a time
- No shift-clicking - prevents bulk crafting
- Storage restrictions - can't be stored in chests, barrels, shulkers, hoppers, bundles, item frames, armor stands, etc.

** 📢 Event Broadcasting**
All major events are announced server-wide:
- Ritual start/completion
- Mace crafting success
- Drop/pickup events
- Destruction notifications

 **⚙️ Admin Commands**
- `/macelimits reload` - Reload configuration
- `/macelimits holders` - View current Mace holders
- `/macelimits clearritual` - Cancel active rituals and drop ingredients
- `/macelimits skiptimer` - skips the timer and instantly crafts the mace of the current ritual

---

 Customization

Extensively configurable via `config.yml`:
- Limits - server/inventory/enchantable/ritual limits
- Ritual - duration, enable/disable 15+ effects individually, particle types, sounds
- Storage - toggle each container type
- Messages - customize all text with color codes and placeholders
- Commands - enable/disable individual admin commands

---

 Why MaceControl?

✅ Scarcity creates value - limited supply makes each Mace precious  
✅ Rituals create memories - dramatic 15-minute ceremonies  
✅ Tracking creates stories - "I have the 1st Mace!" means something  
✅ Restrictions create gameplay - can't hoard, must stay active  
✅ Events create community - server-wide announcements bring players together

Perfect for survival, RPG, event, and economy servers wanting to add prestige and drama to the Mace weapon.

---
WARNING: DELETING THE REGISTERED MACE IN YOUR CREATIVE MENU FREAKS THE PLUGIN OUT AND IT THINKS THE MACE STILL EXISTS. TO FIX JUST REMOVE THE UUID OF THE DELETED MACE IN THE CODE.
*Transform Maces from common weapons into legendary artifacts.
